changelog.title: Beta 7 - Couch mode
items: Couch mode: a fullscreen, controller-first launcher with big covers and a hero panel
Game pages sized for the TV: Play, Favorite, Status and Rating buttons plus Overview, Achievements, Screenshots and News tabs
D-pad / stick to move, A to play or stop, B back, X favourite, Y music, LB / RB tracks, Start to exit
Open it from the top bar, Ctrl+Shift+G, the command palette or Settings > Behaviour > Couch mode
It can start with SteamLite or open when a controller connects

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 7 - Couch mode
news.content: Beta 7 adds Couch mode: a fullscreen launcher you can drive entirely from a gamepad. Big covers in rows, a hero panel with the game you are on, A to open a game page (Play, Favorite, Status, Rating and tabs for Overview, Achievements, Screenshots and News), B to go back, X to favourite and Y for music. Open it from the controller button in the top bar or press Ctrl+Shift+G.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 6 - Spotify now playing
news.content: Beta 6 adds Spotify to SteamLite: a small player in the top bar shows the song and album art with play / pause / next / previous, and clicking it opens a full player with a seekable progress bar. No login is needed. Switch it on in Settings > Behaviour > Now playing (it is off by default).

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 5 - Discord presence upgrade
news.content: Discord Rich Presence is better: your game card has the game art, a correct timer, achievement progress, your streak and View on Steam / Get SteamLite buttons. Not in a game, it shows which page you are on. You can turn each part off or hide game names under Settings > Behaviour > Discord presence, and it now reconnects by itself.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 4 - a Settings page
news.content: Settings is now a full page instead of two pop-up windows: a section list on the left, a search box, and a bar that appears when you have unsaved changes. Everything from Settings and Advanced Settings is there.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 3
news.content: Beta 3 fixes the restart prompt at the end of setup and adds a Stable / Beta switch to the SteamLite Updater, including a way back to the latest stable version from a beta.
